import sys
from array import array
from itertools import accumulate, islice
from operator import xor


def tokens():
    # Stream integers in 1 MiB chunks so the whole input never sits in memory as a token list.
    read = sys.stdin.buffer.read
    rest = b""
    while True:
        chunk = read(1 << 20)
        if not chunk:
            break
        chunk = rest + chunk
        cut = max(chunk.rfind(b" "), chunk.rfind(b"\n"))
        if cut < 0:
            rest = chunk
            continue
        rest = chunk[cut:]
        yield from map(int, chunk[:cut].split())
    yield from map(int, rest.split())


def main():
    it = tokens()
    n = next(it)
    values = array("q", islice(it, n))
    k = next(it)
    # XOR difference array: [l, r] flips the parity of 0-based positions l-1 .. r-1.
    flip = bytearray(n + 1)
    for l in islice(it, k):  # the matching r is taken with next(it)
        flip[l - 1] ^= 1
        flip[next(it)] ^= 1
    # Prefix XOR gives each position's parity; odd parity means negate.
    out = [-v if p else v for v, p in zip(values, accumulate(flip[:n], xor))]
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, out)))
    sys.stdout.write("\n")


main()
